files.rationale: PR B moved the Tool class out of agent.py into serena.tools (tools_base.py) and switched agent.py to the new config/tools import layout, so agent.py follows B; PR A's only agent.py changes were the record_tool_usage import and call in Tool.apply_ex, and that hook now belongs in serena/tools/tools_base.py, so keeping it here would leave an unused import or a broken duplicate Tool class.
